title: The Job Part 1 w/ Paul Lieberstein

sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们还是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专门为你们制作了这档《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们两人才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office ladies.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室女士》。

sentences.en: And it's Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: It's Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And we are here to talk to you this week about the job.
sentences.zh: 这周我们在这里要和大家聊聊《工作》这一集。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's the end of season three, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，这是第三季的结尾了。

sentences.en: This is the season three finale.
sentences.zh: 这是第三季的大结局。

sentences.en: I can't believe we're already at the season three finale.
sentences.zh: 真不敢相信我们已经聊到第三季大结局了。

sentences.en: I can't either.
sentences.zh: 我也不敢相信。

sentences.en: I can't either.
sentences.zh: 我也不敢相信。

sentences.en: I was saying to my husband the other day, I was like, babe, Jenna and I have talked for a year now about the show.
sentences.zh: 前几天我跟我丈夫说，我说，亲爱的，我和珍娜聊这部剧已经聊了一年了。

sentences.en: And it doesn't even feel like any time has gone by.
sentences.zh: 感觉时间好像还没过去多久一样。

sentences.en: I mean, I think we just really enjoy hanging out and talking with each other and also talking about the show.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我觉得我们真的很享受在一起聊天，也享受谈论这部剧的过程。

sentences.en: Well, this is actually the job part one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这一集其实是《工作》的上半部分。

sentences.en: This is an hour-long episode finale, so we're dividing it into two episodes of Office Ladies so that we can really cover everything.
sentences.zh: 这是一集时长一小时的大结局，所以我们把它拆分成两期《办公室女士》来聊，这样我们才能真正把所有细节都讲透。

sentences.en: This was written by Paul Lieberstein and Mike Shore and directed by Ken Kwapis.
sentences.zh: 这一集由保罗·利伯斯坦和迈克·肖尔编剧，肯·卡皮斯执导。

sentences.en: Jenna, do you know it was also co-edited?
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你知道它还有联合剪辑吗？

sentences.en: Not only co-written, but it was co-edited with Dave Rogers and Dean Holland.
sentences.zh: 不仅是联合编剧，它还由戴夫·罗杰斯和迪恩·霍兰德联合剪辑。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Because it was such a big episode.
sentences.zh: 因为这一集太重要了。

sentences.en: We put everyone on this.
sentences.zh: 我们动用了所有人。

sentences.en: All hands on deck.
sentences.zh: 全员出动。

sentences.en: Well, here is a summary for part one.
sentences.zh: 好了，这是上半部分的剧情梗概。

sentences.en: Before leaving for his interview and confident he already has a new job at corporate, Michael names Dwight as his replacement at Dunder Mifflin Scranton.
sentences.zh: 在去参加面试前，迈克尔自信满满地认为自己已经拿到了总公司的工作，于是他任命德怀特为他在邓德·米夫林斯克兰顿分公司的接班人。

sentences.en: Angela could not be more excited.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉对此兴奋不已。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，没错。

sentences.en: But before Michael can leave, Jan pays a surprise visit.
sentences.zh: 但在迈克尔离开之前，简突然造访。

sentences.en: She shows Michael her new breast enhancement and says she wants to get back together.
sentences.zh: 她向迈克尔展示了她刚做的隆胸手术，并表示想和他复合。

sentences.en: Jim and Karen leave early as they are also interviewing for the job at corporate.
sentences.zh: 吉姆和凯伦提前离开了，因为他们也要去总公司面试那个职位。

sentences.en: Dwight makes Andy his number two since Andy is the only person who would interview for the position.
sentences.zh: 德怀特任命安迪为他的二把手，因为安迪是唯一一个愿意来面试这个职位的人。

sentences.en: And that's just the first half.
sentences.zh: 而这仅仅是上半部分。

sentences.en: There's more to come.
sentences.zh: 后面还有更多精彩内容。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, listen, to kick off this finale episode, we have a surprise gueSt.
sentences.zh: 好了，听着，为了开启这集大结局，我们请到了一位惊喜嘉宾。

sentences.en: We're so excited.
sentences.zh: 我们太激动了。

sentences.en: Writer, Toby himself, Paul Lieberstein.
sentences.zh: 编剧，也就是托比本人，保罗·利伯斯坦。

sentences.en: Toby is in the house.
sentences.zh: 托比来了。

sentences.en: Well, you know, in the Zoom house.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，是在Zoom里来了。

sentences.en: Toby's in the Zoom house.
sentences.zh: 托比在Zoom里来了。

sentences.en: Oh, well, we asked him all about being Toby and all about this episode.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们问了他所有关于扮演托比以及关于这一集的问题。

sentences.en: Sam, will you play the interview?
sentences.zh: 萨姆，能播放一下采访录音吗？

sentences.en: Oh, Paul Lieberstein.
sentences.zh: 哦，保罗·利伯斯坦。

sentences.en: Welcome to Office Lady.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《办公室女士》。

sentences.en: Hello, Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 你好，珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: Hello, Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 你好，安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Oh, thanks so much for being on.
sentences.zh: 噢，非常感谢你能来。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: We're so excited to have you today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天能请到你真是太兴奋了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm excited to be here.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: We were texting, and I know you were texting with Angela as well.
sentences.zh: 我们之前发过短信，我知道你也和安吉拉发过短信。

sentences.en: And you told us that you have not seen an episode of the show since it aired, but that you were
sentences.zh: 你告诉我们，自从剧集播出后你就没再看过，但你今天

sentences.en: going to watch the job today.
sentences.zh: 打算看这一集。

sentences.en: How was that experience for you?
sentences.zh: 那次体验对你来说感觉如何？

sentences.en: I'm dying to know.
sentences.zh: 我太想知道了。

sentences.en: It was really interesting.
sentences.zh: 真的很有趣。

sentences.en: I felt like there's moments that really, really shined.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有些时刻真的很棒，非常出彩。

sentences.en: And then there's like, you know, the writer part of me was like, oh, okay, I think I would have done that a little differently now.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，我作为编剧的那部分会想：噢，好吧，我觉得现在我会换种方式来处理。

sentences.en: But I didn't think there was anything that was embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 但我并不觉得有什么令人尴尬的地方。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Look on yourself.
sentences.zh: 对自己宽容点。

sentences.en: This is an amazing, delightful episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一集非常棒、非常令人愉快的剧集。

sentences.en: I know you, and you're such an amazing writer, and I can see you watching things through the filter of like, oh, and you're a producer, and you direct.
sentences.zh: 我了解你，你是一位如此出色的编剧，我能看出你在观看时会带着某种滤镜，毕竟你还是制片人，也参与导演工作。

sentences.en: So I imagine you're watching it through all those different layers.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜你在看的时候会考虑到所有这些不同的层面。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, there's everything.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你知道，什么都有。

sentences.en: It's like framing.
sentences.zh: 比如构图。

sentences.en: It's like, oh, I should be in front of, oh.
sentences.zh: 或者会想：噢，我应该站在前面，噢。

sentences.en: Or that was repetitive.
sentences.zh: 或者觉得那段重复了。

sentences.en: We already said that.
sentences.zh: 我们已经说过那句话了。

sentences.en: Paul.
sentences.zh: 保罗。

sentences.en: We didn't need to do it again.
sentences.zh: 我们没必要再来一遍。

sentences.en: But then I get really impressed with some other stuff.
sentences.zh: 但随后我又会被其他一些东西深深打动。

sentences.en: Well, we do always like to start by asking people how they came to be on The Office.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们总是喜欢先问问大家是如何加入《办公室》剧组的。

sentences.en: You are one of our original writers, and you were with us the entire nine seasons.
sentences.zh: 你是我们的元老级编剧之一，而且整整九季都和我们在一起。

sentences.en: You were our showrunner as well for a period of time.
sentences.zh: 你还曾有一段时间担任过我们的剧集运作人。

sentences.en: How did it come about that you were on the show?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么加入这部剧的呢？

sentences.en: Well, I had worked with Greg Daniels before and known him a very long time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我之前和格雷格·丹尼尔斯合作过，认识他很久了。

sentences.en: And we did King of the Hill together.
sentences.zh: 我们一起做过《山丘之王》。

sentences.en: And when they started the show, I stopped by the pilot.
sentences.zh: 当他们开始筹备这部剧时，我顺道去看了试播集的拍摄。

sentences.en: You know, I had nothing to do with the pilot, but I stopped by a few days.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我跟试播集没什么关系，但我去现场待了几天。

sentences.en: And it was, I just kind of loved what was happening.
sentences.zh: 当时，我简直爱上了正在发生的一切。

sentences.en: And it was, you know, I loved the British.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我喜欢英版的那种风格。

sentences.en: And so then when it got picked up, I was psyched that he asked me to come on.
sentences.zh: 所以当剧集被预订后，他邀请我加入时，我感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: So there's just like kind of a very traditional thing that writers and actors are kind of separating on a TV show.
sentences.zh: 当时电视圈有一种非常传统的做法，就是编剧和演员是分开的。

sentences.en: You know, and they're kind of asked not to talk.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们通常被要求不要交流。

sentences.en: And he, at this point, was questioning a lot of those, like, rules and why is this happening?
sentences.zh: 而他在当时就在质疑很多这样的规则，比如为什么要这样？

sentences.en: And does this really make a better TV show?
sentences.zh: 这真的能让电视节目变得更好吗？

sentences.en: So we talked about roles for, it was Mindy and BJ and myself and Mike.
sentences.zh: 所以我们讨论了角色分配，当时有敏迪、BJ、我还有迈克。

sentences.en: And then there was a couple of consultants.
sentences.zh: 还有几位顾问。

sentences.en: There was Lester and Larry.
sentences.zh: 莱斯特和拉里。

sentences.en: So the four of us each got, like, little roles.
sentences.zh: 所以我们四个人每人都得到了一些小角色。

sentences.en: I guess Mike's didn't come on.
sentences.zh: 我猜迈克的那部分没播出来。

sentences.en: Most didn't start that season.
sentences.zh: 那一季大多数都没开始。

sentences.en: But so we had talked about just doing a little thing to kind of have the experience of being an actor.
sentences.zh: 所以我们讨论过只是做点小事，体验一下当演员的感觉。

sentences.en: And hopefully it would inform our writing.
sentences.zh: 希望这能为我们的写作提供灵感。

sentences.en: So here he wanted to kind of, like, break that down together.
sentences.zh: 所以他想在这里一起把那个拆解开来。

sentences.en: So I feel like I'm not sure how Toey happened, but I feel like I left the room and I came back and they said, you're going to play this part.
sentences.zh: 我不确定托比这个角色是怎么来的，但我感觉我离开房间再回来时，他们就说，你要演这个角色。

sentences.en: And it was one line, you know, in Diversity Day about, you know, I say this one line and get kicked out of the room.
sentences.zh: 那只有一句台词，你知道，在《多元化日》那一集里，我说了那一句台词就被赶出了房间。

sentences.en: Now, I heard, Paul, and you tell me if this is true, I heard that at the table read, they had you read that line and that Steve, as Michael,
sentences.zh: 现在，我听说，保罗，你告诉我这是不是真的，我听说在剧本围读会上，他们让你读那句台词，然后史蒂夫，作为迈克尔，

sentences.en: jumped on you so viciously and everyone erupted in laughter.
sentences.zh: 非常凶猛地扑向你，大家都哄堂大笑。

sentences.en: Because you sort of almost reacted a little bit as yourself and a little bit maybe how you thought Tobey might, you know, but you still didn't know who Tobey was at that moment,
sentences.zh: 因为你当时的反应有点像你自己，也有点像你觉得托比可能会有的反应，你知道，但你当时还不知道托比是谁，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: You're still discovering who is Tobey.
sentences.zh: 你还在探索托比到底是谁。

sentences.en: There were early table reads where it was just, for, like, weird contractual reasons, just the main five actors.
sentences.zh: 早期的剧本围读会，因为一些奇怪的合同原因，只有主要的五位演员参加。

sentences.en: And I was reading Kevin.
sentences.zh: 当时我在读凯文的台词。

sentences.en: Yeah, you read a few roles.
sentences.zh: 没错，你读过好几个角色。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think I did well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我表现得不错。

sentences.en: I think I got laughs as Kevin.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我演凯文时逗笑了大家。

sentences.en: I think that the supporting cast wasn't there because you were guest stars and you were not series regular.
sentences.zh: 我想配角没去是因为你们是客串明星，不是常规演员。

sentences.en: So in a series regular contract, you're required to do the table read.
sentences.zh: 因为在常规演员合同里，你是必须参加剧本围读的。

sentences.en: It's part of your acting deal.
sentences.zh: 这是你表演协议的一部分。

sentences.en: But I think they have to pay you more.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得他们必须多付你钱。

sentences.en: Oh, to attend those?
sentences.zh: 哦，参加那些围读吗？

sentences.en: If you don't have that kind of contract.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有那种合同的话。

sentences.en: That sounds right.
sentences.zh: 听起来确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, it's interesting because I, as a guest star, they say you're invited.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很有趣，因为作为客串明星，他们会说你是受邀参加的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Not required.
sentences.zh: 不是必须的。

sentences.en: You're invited if you would like to come.
sentences.zh: 如果你想来，你是受邀的。

sentences.en: And I always do.
sentences.zh: 我总是会去。

sentences.en: But I think you're right, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得你说得对，珍娜。

sentences.en: It wasn't until after Boo's Cruise that we started coming to table reads.
sentences.zh: 直到《布的游轮》之后，我们才开始参加剧本围读会。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, Paul, you read a bunch of roles and everyone laughed when Michael jumped on you as Toby.
sentences.zh: 所以，保罗，你读了很多角色，当迈克尔作为托比扑向你时，大家都笑了。

sentences.en: And I feel like that helped seal the deal.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这有助于敲定这个角色。

sentences.en: But we also didn't expect that part to come back ever.
sentences.zh: 但我们也从没想过这个角色会再出现。

sentences.en: Oh, that's how they got you.
sentences.zh: 哦，他们就是这样套住你的。

sentences.en: That's what Mike Schur said about Moe's.
sentences.zh: 迈克·舒尔就是这么说莫斯的。

sentences.en: It was just supposed to be a silly photo, you know?
sentences.zh: 那本来只是张愚蠢的照片，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: He started as a photo.
sentences.zh: 他最初只是张照片。

sentences.en: And then years later, he had to walk around with that beard for like a whole year, a whole season, because Greg wouldn't let him use a fake one.
sentences.zh: 然后几年后，他不得不留着那把胡子整整一年，整整一季，因为格雷格不让他用假胡子。

sentences.en: And it all started because he was just going to be in a photo.
sentences.zh: 而这一切的开始，仅仅是因为他要出现在一张照片里。

sentences.en: And then the fake one looked better, I think.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得假胡子看起来效果更好。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then he was furious because he had had that huge beard and the fake one worked just as well.
sentences.zh: 然后他气疯了，因为他留了那么大的胡子，而假胡子的效果其实是一样的。

sentences.en: Well, Paul, how was that experience?
sentences.zh: 那么，保罗，那次经历感觉如何？

sentences.en: Was Greg right?
sentences.zh: 格雷格说对了吗？

sentences.en: Did you feel like you learned from the experience of being an actor?
sentences.zh: 你觉得从这次当演员的经历中学到了什么吗？

sentences.en: I absolutely did.
sentences.zh: 我绝对学到了。

sentences.en: But it took a while to get there.
sentences.zh: 但花了一段时间才领悟到。

sentences.en: I don't know if you remember, but we were doing this kind of room bit about like my acting school.
sentences.zh: 不知道你还记不记得，我们当时在聊关于我表演学校的事。

sentences.en: I do remember your acting school bit.
sentences.zh: 我记得你说的表演学校那段。

sentences.en: It's okay.
sentences.zh: 还行吧。

sentences.en: So imagine going into acting, knowing nothing about acting.
sentences.zh: 试想一下，你对表演一窍不通，却去学了表演。

sentences.en: And the first thing you're being taught is take your water bottle off your desk and put it underneath your desk because the label isn't cleared.
sentences.zh: 你学到的第一件事竟然是：把桌上的水瓶拿走放到桌下，因为标签没经过授权。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That's now the first thing I know about acting.
sentences.zh: 这就是我现在关于表演的第一认知。

sentences.en: You know, and it was like things like that that made up my acting school.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是诸如此类的事情构成了我的表演学校经历。

sentences.en: I remember.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: Also, I remember Rain would just ride you so hard.
sentences.zh: 我还记得雷恩当时对你要求特别严。

sentences.en: Like, you go, hey, Kate.
sentences.zh: 比如，你说，嘿，凯特。

sentences.en: And she goes, hey, Paul.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，嘿，保罗。

sentences.en: And you're like, dang it.
sentences.zh: 你就觉得，该死。

sentences.en: Because she was supposed to be Meredith in the moment you're in a scene.
sentences.zh: 因为在演戏的时候，她当时应该扮演梅雷迪思。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: And I remember Rain would like tease you so hard.
sentences.zh: 我记得雷恩当时总是那样狠狠地逗你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。
